date.as_written: śālivāhanaśāke ʼsmin naṃdavāṇakalāṃkite || caitramāsi site pakṣe daśamyāṃ ravivāsare

purpose: upakārārtham ātmārthapaṭhanaṃ ca hi (for the benefit of others and for one's own reading)
